title: North Korea fires about a dozen short-range ballistic missiles after Seoul's offer
note: South Korea's Joint Chiefs report a salvo of roughly a dozen short-range ballistic missiles toward the East Sea, coming right after Seoul's dialogue offer. South Korea's defense minister denounced the launches at an ASEAN defense forum.
limitations: Launch details come from South Korean military statements; North Korea's own account and intent are not given. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: US sanctions Rwanda's defense ministry over support for M23 in eastern Congo
note: The US State Department sanctions Rwanda's Ministry of Defense and a financial institution serving its security services, saying thousands of Rwandan troops fight alongside M23 in North and South Kivu. The step aims to pressure Kigali but may harden positions in a war with a mineral trade dimension.
metricName: Rwandan troops reported fighting with M23
limitations: The troop claim is a US government assertion; Rwanda has historically denied backing M23. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defenses amid Tigray fighting
note: The BBC reports Ethiopia has obtained Russian warplanes and air defense systems while fighting in northern Tigray, which began last month, continues. New air power raises the risk of wider escalation in the region.
limitations: The summary gives no numbers or delivery dates for the aircraft and systems. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Ship reported on fire in Strait of Hormuz as Iran says it downed another US drone
note: A British maritime agency reports a vessel on fire in the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran says it shot down another US drone. The incidents add to fears of renewed US-Iran fighting around a key oil route.
limitations: The cause of the fire is not established, and the drone claim is Iranian and unverified. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: European Central Bank president resigns as oil shock and bond yields bite
note: The Japan Times reports the ECB's president has resigned while the bank faces inflation risks from an Iran-driven oil shock and a sharp rise in bond yields. A leadership gap at the central bank adds uncertainty to Europe's economic response to the Gulf conflict.

title: UN support for ending the US embargo on Cuba falls to a 20-year low
note: The General Assembly calls for the 34th time for an end to the US economic, commercial and financial embargo on Cuba, but with the weakest backing in two decades. The weaker vote suggests slipping international resistance to long-running US sanctions.
limitations: The summary gives no vote counts, so the size of the decline and the reasons for it are not stated. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.
